items: ✨【Wide Compatibility】Vmag-S1 magnetic phone mount is designed for iPhone with MagSafe (iP-hone 12/13/14/15/16/17 series) and Android phones (Samsung, Google, Motorola, OnePlus). items.value: ❓Draw a circle with your fingernail-if the surface feels smooth and there is no sound, there is no need to use an adhesive pad for installation. ⚠️After attaching the adhesive pad, please let it stand for at least 2 hours before installing the phone holder 🔄How to choose: MSXTTLY nano gel pad can be reused multiple times by washing, and can be easily removed without leaving marks. items: ✨【Versatile Use】This phone holders for your car is not just for cars; it adheres to dashboard,, windshields,mirrors, and screens, making it perfect for driving, workouts, or cooking. For surfaces that require enhanced adhesion, use the included nano gel pad for repositioning or the circular PC pad for a more permanent installation. Upgrade your car accessories with this powerful and versatile tesla phone holder!

🧲【Super Strong Magnetic Force】The magsafe car mount is equipped with 22 N52 grade neodymium iron boron magnets, providing a strong suction force of up to 2200gf. After thousands of vibration tests and extreme road condition simulations, it ensures that the phone is always firmly connected in various extreme road environments.Tested in extreme conditions, tesla model 3 phone mount securely holds your phone without signal interference, ensuring stable navigation and clear calls.
